checked.description:
Whether the checkbox item is currently ticked.
To render an uncontrolled checkbox item, use the defaultChecked prop instead.

classes.description: Override or extend the styles applied to the component.

closeOnClick.description: Whether to close the menu when the item is clicked.

defaultChecked.description:
Whether the checkbox item is initially ticked.
To render a controlled checkbox item, use the checked prop instead.

disabled.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

disableGutters.description: If true, the left and right padding is removed.

disableRipple.description: If true, the ripple effect is disabled.

divider.description: If true, a 1px light border is added to the bottom of the menu item.

label.description: Overrides the text label to use when the item is matched during keyboard text navigation.

nativeButton.description: Whether the item renders a native <button> element. Inferred from slots.root="button" or a button element passed to render. Set to true for a custom component or render function that returns a button.

onCheckedChange.description: Event handler called when the checkbox item is ticked or unticked.

eventDetails.name: eventDetails
eventDetails.description: The reason for the change and the native event.

render.description: The element to render, or a function that returns it. Forward the props, ref, and children to preserve Material styles, the indicator, and ripple. Put content in the children prop of Menu2CheckboxItem. Replacing the supplied children can remove the indicator and ripple. Applies to the default root only. Use slots.root to replace the styled root.

slotProps.description: The props used for each slot inside.

slots.description: The components used for each slot inside.

sx.description: The system prop that allows defining system overrides as well as additional CSS styles.

slotDescriptions.indicator: The component that renders the check indicator.
slotDescriptions.indicatorIcon: The component that renders the icon inside the indicator.
slotDescriptions.root: The component that renders the root. Replaces the default styled root and takes precedence over render.
